1. REFORMED 4-VALUE VISTAMATIONS IDENTIFIERS
--------------------------------------------
We have upgraded our naming structures from a 3-value convention to a 4-value convention to support the new hybrid local-to-cloud topology.
All file names, databases, credentials, configurations, and ledger keys must strictly conform to this machine-parsable 4-value structure:

Format: org-system-category-item(no.)
(Four values separated by exactly three hyphens)

* DEFINITION OF COMPONENTS:
  - org: Organization identifier. Locked to "vista" across all modules.
  - system: The subsystem layer where the entity resides:
    - "local" (Your local Windows/Docker sub-system)
    - "cloud" (The Cloudflare serverless / VPS edge sub-system)
  - category: The functional resource type:
    - "agent" (Dominion I Agents AG001 to AG010)
    - "storage" (R2, localStorage, file assets, disks)
    - "db" (D1 SQLite, local JSON files, SQLite DBs)
    - "comms" (Slack webhooks, Telegram APIs, emails)
    - "cron" (Wrangler triggers, task schedulers)
  - item(no.): The specific file name, task index, or resource label.

* KEY IMPLEMENTATION EXAMPLES:
  - vista-cloud-storage-config.json (Cloudflare R2 and domain settings)
  - vista-local-storage-playlist.json (Local Media Centre playlist file)
  - vista-local-agent-AG001 (Gordon's core local Docker orchestration container)
  - vista-cloud-agent-AG004 (Olivia's central edge router running on Cloudflare Workers)
  - vista-cloud-db-links.json (Cloudflare D1 SQL ledger syncing the Evidence Registry)
  - vista-local-queue-task0047.json (Olivia's local pending file queue task)
  - vista-cloud-comms-slackWebhook (The webhook credentials for enterprise Slack)

2. SYSTEM MAP: TRINITY-QUAD HYBRID SUB-SYSTEM
---------------------------------------------
With the introduction of the Trinity-Core and Trinity-Quad VM topology, the Vistamations architecture is mathematically formalized as:

System = Local Sub-System + Cloud Sub-System

* TRINITY-QUAD CORE STRUCTURAL COMPONENTS:
  - vista-local-agent-trinityCore: Local systems bridge running in Docker.
  - vista-cloud-agent-trinityWorker: Edge computing layer running on Cloudflare Workers.
  - vista-cloud-db-trinityD1: Serverless cloud database syncing state to local.
  - vista-cloud-storage-trinityR2: High-capacity external S3-compatible cloud storage.

3. OCCURRING LEDGER PATTERNS ACQUIRED TO DATE:
----------------------------------------------
* DOMINIONS (vista-system-dominion-DOM###):
  - vista-local-dominion-DOM001: Foundation (Nginx, App, Redis, Prometheus, local OpenClaw)
  - vista-cloud-dominion-DOM002: Knowledge (Edge publishing, Cloudflare D1, links archive)
  - vista-local-dominion-DOM003: Media (Root-level media-player.html, playlists, skins)
  - vista-cloud-dominion-DOM004: Expansion (Cloud agent workers, gcloud endpoints, DNS)
  - vista-cloud-dominion-DOM005: Corporation (Slack audit channels, business email info@)

* ACTIVE PROTOCOLS (vista-system-protocol-xCode):
  - vista-local-protocol-xinitiate: The mandatory Review-Validate-Verify-Confirm sequence.
